key_idea: Find half of 20, then see how many coloured squares are missing.
steps: Count the coloured squares row by row: 2 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 6.

choice_feedback.B: 6 is how many squares are coloured now, not how many more are needed.
choice_feedback.C: With 8 more there would be 14 coloured squares, more than half.
choice_feedback.D: 10 is half of all the squares, but 6 are already coloured.
choice_feedback.E: 14 is how many squares are white now. Colouring all of them is too many.
